verdict.hypothesis: H4: the expensive panels are expensive because of the RPC they trigger and/or an uncached host-side rescan
supported_for: 通用设置 (General) panel: only via subagent.list (224.1 ms median, 121x the fast-method median), which is an UNCACHED full-filesystem rescan and is triggered by session-selection change, not by the section itself
the general mechanism: session.list and subagent.list both call sessionPersistence.list() per call with no memo, walking 1049 session dirs / 1052 log files / 578 MB every time
not_supported_for: 插件列表 (Plugin list) tab: pluginInventory/list is 1.4 ms median, 21719 B, 177 entries, in-memory loader walk, 208-218 calls/s, no rescan

the remaining General-section mount RPCs: settings.describe, skill.list, commands/list, session.models, llm.providers, credentials.describe, session.history, dynamicCordisRunner/inventory are all <= 7.3 ms median
verdict.key_finding: the expensive/smooth split does not map onto RPC sets; it maps onto whether subagent.list / session.list happen to be in flight. General's single 224 ms item is a session-selection-driven call that the 'smooth' sections also trigger on session change.

prior_finding_check.claim: dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js ~2237 calls sessionListMetadata(events) inside a sort comparator (O(N log N) folds, no memo); session.list is 0.166 s median after a hotfix
prior_finding_check.comparator_claim: REFUTED for current code: the comparator is gone, replaced by a precomputed attachedRecency Map (index.js:2237-2243)
prior_finding_check.0.166s_claim: REFUTED: my >=15-sample medians are 282.6 / 336.9 / 477.2 ms. Best run 282.6 ms = 1.7x the claimed figure and it is the fastest of three
prior_finding_check.conclusion: hotfix is present and removed the algorithmic multiplier, but session.list remains the slowest mount-adjacent RPC because the dominant cost is persistence.list() (index.js:2255) plus a 496 KB response, not the comparator

routing.why_pluginInventory_slash_404s: POST /api/pluginInventory.list hits the unary table, whose methodFor requires an exact own key; 'pluginInventory.list' is not a key, so 404. The real endpoint is the two-segment Remote route /api/pluginInventory/list, claimed by the gateway interceptor which is consulted before the apiproxy fallback (dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:235-238).
routing.remote_payload_shape: {"args":{}} — a plain OBJECT. {"args":[]} yields HTTP 200 + business error 'Remote payload must contain exactly one plain-object args field' (dsh-api-gateway/lib/types/index.js:142-148).

parent_independence.note: cost is independent of the parent id: the whole corpus is built before filtering (dsh-subagent/lib/index.js:1863-1889)

client_trigger.note: not section-scoped: fired on session selection change and reconnect, independent of which settings section is open

subagent.list.verdict: the ONLY host-expensive General-section mount RPC; slow rather than blocking (I/O-parked on the filesystem walk)

pluginInventory/list.caching_verdict: no cache BY DESIGN, but also no rescan: a synchronous walk of the Cordis loader's in-memory entry store; no readdir, no import(), no module-graph walk, no disk hit

scan_loop_citation.quote: list() { const entries = []; for (const entry of this.ctx.loader.entries()) { if (entry.options.group) continue; entries.push({...}); } return { entries }; }

loader_source_citation.quote: *entries() { for (const entry of Object.values(this.store)) { yield entry; if (!entry.subtree) continue; yield* entry.subtree.entries(); } }

design_note_citation.quote: Read the Loader directly on every call. Cordis's internal plugin/status events already maintain Entry.fiber and Fiber.state, so a second cache would only add another lifecycle truth to keep synchronized.

client_note.quote: useEffect(() => { list().then(setState ready) }, [list, request]); useMemo filter over snapshot.entries — fetch once on mount, no further host RPC

4way_4s.note: relative 4.4x inflation on a 1 ms baseline; absolute delta 3.4 ms = probe curl spawn under CPU sharing, not host slowness

pluginInventory/list.verdict: NOT an H4 offender; the 插件列表 tab's perceived cost is not this RPC

dynamicCordisRunner/inventory.caching_verdict: no cache; registry.all() = [...this.plugins.values()] over an in-memory Map, plus shallow cloneAttempt copies; no fs I/O; does not need a cache

settings.describe.caching_verdict: served from an in-memory registration snapshot (registration.resolved is deepFreeze'd at register time / swapped on commit), NOT a per-call disk read; but every call re-runs structuredClone + schema.toJSON() + redactSecrets for 20 namespaces and re-serialises 43.5 KB synchronously
citations: dsh-settings-file/lib/index.js:179-196 (chokidar watcher keeps the document in memory)
settings.describe.verdict: cheap; not an H4 offender (its 43.5 KB lands in the browser, not on the host)
